description: Nightly CRM-to-ERP customer master sync job CRM_CUST_SYNC_NIGHT failed at record 14,502 of 89,000. Error CRM-SYNC-901: Duplicate external ID conflict — source record CUST-88421 maps to existing ERP BP 2000148892 with mismatched tax ID. 74,498 records synced before failure; delta sync halted.
resolution: Identified duplicate customer created manually in ERP during data migration (BP 2000148892) conflicting with CRM golden record CUST-88421. Merged duplicate in ERP using transaction XD99, updated CRM external ID mapping table crm_erp_xref, and re-ran sync from checkpoint record 14,502. Full sync completed; reconciliation report shows 89,000/89,000 matched.
